Read-only: never toggles the learning switch, never deletes.
timeline body, rows, Index spotlight, detail sheet, filters, empty/error, source contract, manifest, DE/EN topic coverage
tests.reason: Hiding an entry from Vitana and deleting it are writes to the shared production database, so staging never exercises them; these suites prove the wiring (mutation called with the entry id) with the gateway client mocked, and that measured influence is shown only when the gateway measured it.
